chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ismail ibn Sa'd al-Ash'ari, from al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the zakat, 'Can it be placed among those who do not recognize (wilayah)?' He said: 'No, nor the zakat of al-fitra.'

key_terms.الْفِطْرَة: Fitra (a specific charitable payment, often associated with Eid al-Fitr)
key_terms.الْوَليَاة: Wilayah (guardianship/authority, specifically referring to the Imams)

ai.seo_question: Who is eligible to receive zakat according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Rida (AS), the concept of 'Ghuraba' (strangers) or those outside the fold of Wilayah is addressed regarding the distribution of zakat. The Imam clarifies that just as zakat is withheld from those who do not acknowledge the Imamate, so too is the zakat al-fitr, emphasizing a consistent theological criterion for charity recipients. This ruling underscores the spiritual and political dimensions of Wilayah in Shia jurisprudence, linking financial purification to doctrinal recognition.
